messages:
Maya: Kicking off prod canary for v2.3.4 now — change window 03/21 02:00-03:00 UTC. Will ramp to 3% initially for 15m, SLO watch on p95 and 5xx. tagging @sre-pager and @Ryan. :rocket:

deploy-bot: starting rollout v2.3.4 -> route: /generate, /chat, /embeddings. canary_pct=3, rollout_id=rl-20260321-01. healthchecks: readiness, kv-cache hitrate, p95_latency.

Ryan: saw a small p95 blip on /chat at first minute, ~280ms -> baseline 140ms. 5xx still 0.02%. watching.

Lina: adding quick check: nginx 429s trending on embed-proxy-2: `rate_limited_requests: 12 -> 37 in 60s` could be unrelated, but call it out.

Maya: thanks. keeping canary at 3% for the full 15m. If p95 > 300ms for 3 consecutive 1m buckets OR 5xx > 0.5% for 5m we pause and pin.

Carlos: grabbing relevant logs: ```kubectl -n prod logs deploy/embed-proxy-2 --since=3m | rg "429|timeout"``` seeing upstream timeout 504 from quantizer-service.

Ryan: quantizer-service CPU spike on one pod, OOM killer not triggered but GC cycles high. CPU ~95% on pod q-7f2. Could be new model variant memory pattern.

Maya: good catch. I'll ask rollout to exclude embeddings route if we need to avoid broad impact. for now hold.

deploy-bot: canary status: HEALTHY -> WARNING (p95 crossing threshold). Current canary_pct=3. Actions available: pause, rollback(v2.3.3), exclude-route(/embeddings), continue.

Lina: proposal: pause traffic shift and exclude /embeddings from v2.3.4 (keep embeddings on v2.3.3) then continue canary for chat/generate. Safer until quantizer fix.

Maya: +1. execute exclude-route. Also opening a short incident in ops room: "embeddings quantizer regression" with link to runbook.

Ryan: once excluded, I'll watch p95 for next 10m. If we see improvement, we continue ramp. If not, rollback full rollout.

deploy-bot: action executed: route exclusion applied -> /embeddings pinned to v2.3.3. canary_pct remains 3. Notifying traffic router.

Maya: thanks everyone. monitoring dashboard link: https://console.redwood/slo/dashboard?env=prod&rollout=rl-20260321-01. Will update in 10m. :hourglass: 

sre-pager: I'll stay on watch for 30m. If metrics re-stabilize, we proceed with gradual ramp; if any 5xx >0.5% sustained, we rollback.

Carlos: quantizer team looped in — they see a GC regression with the new weights. They have a hotfix branch (q-fix-20260321) ready if exclusion isn't enough.

Maya: plan: continue canary for chat/generate, keep embeddings pinned, track SLOs. escalate and rollback if conditions breach. will post final decision in this thread. :white_check_mark:
